source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Duet Sport Front-Load Dryer (Job Aid L-79)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Diagnostic mode entered (saved/active F-xx codes reviewed if applicable). Continue with component tests below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After diagnostic entry, proceed with OEM component test steps.

steps.title: Door Switch diagnostic (live)
steps.body: In diagnostic mode, advance to Door Switch diagnostic. Opening/closing door should beep and show alphanumeric codes (e.g. 0E, 09). Wrong model code with door closed indicates a fault.
steps.sourceExcerpt: In diagnostic mode, advance to Door Switch diagnostic. Opening/closing door should beep and show alphanumeric codes (e.g. 0E, 09). Wrong model code with door closed indicates a fault.

steps.title: Door switch diagnostic result
steps.body: Does door open/close produce beep and expected display codes with door properly closed?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Does door open/close produce beep and expected display codes with door properly closed?

steps.title: Bench door switch — P8-3 to P8-4
steps.body: Disconnect power. Ohmmeter across P8-3 (neutral, white) and P8-4 (door, tan) at MCE. Door closed: 0–2 Ω.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Ohmmeter across P8-3 (neutral, white) and P8-4 (door, tan) at MCE. Door closed: 0–2 Ω.

steps.title: Door closed resistance 0–2 Ω
steps.body: With door properly closed, does P8-3 to P8-4 read 0–2 Ω?
steps.sourceExcerpt: With door properly closed, does P8-3 to P8-4 read 0–2 Ω?

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Replace wire and door switch assembly.

steps.title: Inspect door switch harness
steps.body: Verify harness between door switch and MCE. Repair opens; replace door switch assembly if wiring OK.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify harness between door switch and MCE. Repair opens; replace door switch assembly if wiring OK.

steps.title: Replace door switch
steps.oemOutcome: Replace wire and door switch assembly; retest. If still fails, replace MCE.

steps.title: Door switch verified
steps.oemOutcome: Door switch diagnostic and/or bench checks pass.
